conversation.contentPreview:
Build a Todo app in a single self-contained HTML file. Requirements:
- Add new todos
- Mark todos as complete (strikethrough)
- Delete todos
- Filter: All / Active / Completed
- Persist to localStorage

Deliver only the HTML file with JS, CSS, HTML. Use file name "todo_anthropic-claude-sonnet-5_01.html"

toolCallDetails.arguments:
{"path":"todo_anthropic-claude-sonnet-5_01.html","edit_description":"Create a complete, self-contained single-file Todo app (HTML+CSS+JS all in one file, no external dependencies). Requirements:
- Clean, modern, centered card UI with a title "Todo App", an input field + "Add" button to add new todos (add on button click and on Enter key press).
- Each todo item shows: a checkbox to toggle complete/incomplete (completed items get a strikethrough text-decoration and muted/gray color), the todo text, and a delete button (e.g. an "×" icon) to remove that item.
- Filter controls: three buttons/tabs "All", "Active", "Completed" that filter the visible list accordingly; the active filter button should be visually highlighted.
- Show a small counter of remaining active (not completed) items, and a "Clear completed" button that removes all completed todos.
- Persist todos array (id, text, completed) to localStorage under a key like "todos-anthropic-claude", and load/render them on page load so state survives refresh.
- All JS should be vanilla (no frameworks), wrapped in a DOMContentLoaded listener or placed at bottom of body, using functions to render the list, save to localStorage, add/toggle/delete/filter todos.
- Include an empty-state message when there are no todos (or none matching the current filter).
- Responsive, nice-looking design with a pleasant color palette, rounded corners, subtle shadows, good spacing, works well on mobile too.
- Escape/sanitize todo text when rendering to avoid HTML injection (use textContent, not innerHTML for user text).
- Everything (HTML, CSS in a <style> tag, JS in a <script> tag) must be in this single file."}
